title: Tari Arisan
creator: gmXBT
summary: MIT-licensed rotating savings-circle source with a walletless simulation and a documented Esmeralda deployment. Fixed members contribute each round; unpaid contributions become arrears, and a recipient in arrears misses that round's payout. The creator documents template f230b6fbe6409c10c8f3d9dbf47a722a0b7ab956d32ed5b57a1fd35e9e8399a5 and circle component_fe42c4e6f21f2066cac7acdabb5fabcd9bd365af8aadd154ece22dd0d2f601e8. November 17, 2026: the official Esmeralda indexer returned that circle as an up substate at version 3. The hosted page opens in simulation mode and its extracted live-mode instructions still contain older Phase 3 setup text; use the dated creator proof for deployment scope. No mainnet deployment is claimed. This README walkthrough does not demonstrate wallet interaction or independently replay the creator's payout tests.
cardSummary: Explore rotating savings contributions, missed-payment arrears and scheduled pot payouts through an Esmeralda contract and browser simulation.
